messages:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a small change to precision profiles so the runtime can gate risky profile changes by an explicit quality budget. TL;DR: add quality_target + degradation_budget + profile-diff signal so rollouts can be auto-rejected if expected quality loss > budget.
eric: sketch the shape? want to see minimal example to vet runtime contract.
maya: here is the sketch I used in the canary tests (informal):
```json
{
  "profile_name": "balanced_lowbit_v2",
  "quality_target": "3.5",          // scaled quality score (lower better)
  "degradation_budget": "0.05",    // allowed relative drop vs baseline
  "layers": {
    "attention": "int8",
    "mlp": "4bit",
    "embed": "fp8"
  },
  "telemetry_hooks": [ "per_token_conf", "loglikelihood_sample" ],
  "rollback_policy": "auto-fallback-to-last-good"
}
```
maya: note the numeric quality_target maps to our eval harness (we'll compute expected delta in the profile-diff tool). Also added telemetry_hooks so runtime knows which extra signals to stream for early detection.
sana: I like it. Two notes: 1) quality_target needs a canonical mapping doc to eval metrics (BLEU/QA-F1/our degr_score) otherwise teams will pick inconsistent targets; 2) we should default telemetry sampling to 1% for non-production models to limit cost.
liam: telemetry cost question — if telemetry_hooks includes per_token_conf and loglikelihood_sample, what's retention and retention cost? sampling 1% still might be heavy for high-QPS endpoints.
maya: agreed. plan: per-profile sampling_percent (default 0.01) + headroom cap at runtime (max_events_per_minute). Runtime will drop extra events and emit a sampling_warning metric.
eric: runtime contract? what's the payload when a profile is rejected/accepted? we need stable codes for the console + rollout automation.
maya: planned response shape (informal snippet):
```json
{
  "profile_name": "balanced_lowbit_v2",
  "status": "rejected",
  "reason_code": "expected_degradation_exceeds_budget",
  "expected_delta": "0.072",
  "budget": "0.05"
}
```
eric: perfect. include a "suggested_fallback": "balanced_lowbit_v1" field? UI will use that.
maya: yes good call. will add.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for 2642008000 to eng-sandbox, notifier will post status during the window.
sana: operational checklist: 1) run profile-diff vs baseline on 3 eval slices, 2) do small-scale online A/B for 24h with sampling, 3) set alert if degradation_score > budget for 10m.
liam: one more edge: models with long-tail prompts (docs ingestion) showed weird token-level conf spikes under int4 in earlier tests. propose we add a per-prompt-length override that forces attention to int8 when length>4096.
maya: agreed — adding "overrides" in profile schema: { "prompt_length": [{"min":4096,"precision":"int8"}] }
eric: action items then: maya to update profile schema + canonical mapping doc; sana to wire alerts and sampling defaults in console; liam to prepare short stress test for long prompts; ops to watch canary window.
maya: thanks — i'll post the updated schema and the profile-diff tool output format after the sandbox canary. :thumbsup:
